state:
**Side goal `website-overhaul`, stage 4 (Syntax) is in progress. These pages are written: "Start here", the Basics, "Values and types", Operators, Control flow, Errors, Functions, Classes and objects, Programs and files, and Concurrency.**

`tools/nv/cmd/site.ts` `syntaxProblems` is the `syntax` part, tested in `tools/nv/test/site.test.ts`. Every Syntax page except `syntax/index.mdx` needs a non-empty `covers:`, a `<Snippet>` and a `## Do and don't` list.

On disk: `website/src/content/docs/syntax/` has `start-here.mdx`, `basics/`, `values/`, `operators/`, `control-flow/`, `errors/`, `functions/`, `classes/`, `programs/` (3 pages) and `concurrency/` (4 pages). Snippets sit under `website/snippets/syntax/<dir>/` and must exit 0 when run from the repo root, so a child or helper file (a `require`d file, an autoloaded class, a `spawn script` child) is itself a snippet: it needs a `.out` (empty is fine), a page that shows it, and must not throw when run alone (`isolates/check-stock.nvs` throws only when `args:` says so). An `nvs.toml` beside a snippet is passed as `--config` (`site.ts` `snippetProblems`), which is how `file-paths/` grants `fs.read` and `isolates/` grants `script.spawn`. A snippet dir name must not clash with an existing one. Sidebar entries are in `website/astro.config.ts`, stamps in `website/site.lock.json` (`bun nv site --stamp syntax/<group>/<page>.mdx ...`). A front-matter value with `: ` in it must be quoted.

`site structure`, `stale` and `reference` pass. `site syntax` reports 16 uncovered features: `lang:attributes/*` (9) and `lang:testing/*` (7). `snippets` and `prose` fail only on `index.mdx`, `install/*`, `sponsoring.mdx` and `in-depth/what-changed.mdx`, which stages 5 and 6 rewrite.
